body.title: Follow agent experiments
body.problem: Iterative agent work lacks a durable goal and experiment history that people can inspect.
body.objective: See what an agent is improving, its experiment results, and what it learned.

suggestedSlices.title: Record and inspect an agent’s experiments
acceptance: Agents record durable goals and attempts with safe retries and validated references.
People inspect honest results and progress in a screenshot-readable view.
Experiment reports never change verification or permission semantics.

suggestedSlices.title: Read test results and visual evidence first
acceptance: Expand a requirement card to see test descriptions and captured results before collapsed source and command details, with clear status colors and a compact Run again action.
Inspect an integrity-checked local screenshot as visual evidence without treating it as a passing test; unavailable or changed images remain explicit.

suggestedSlices.title: Require screenshots for visual work
acceptance: A passing requirement does not repeat current-pass, finished-run or successful exit metadata above its output; historical, failed, pending and unavailable evidence stays clear.
Visual slices require current screenshots covering every declared UI surface before close or completion, with actionable missing-evidence errors through shared checks and agent tools.
Screenshots are recorded through guarded CLI and MCP operations with source, plan and file integrity; nonvisual and legacy work remain compatible.
